The terminal done carries id, role, text, citations, grounded, used_web, scope, topic_ids and created_at. Each citation carries marker, chunk_id, origin, title, locator, url, snippet and provenance: null, or for harvested external material the cited version's stored {source_url, revision_id, revision_url, attribution, licence, licence_url}; OpenStax material has revision_id null and adds revision_key (git blob SHA-1 of the source module). A terminal error carries {message, code}. After the stream opens an error is an event within the HTTP 200 response.
